title: Mangroves as Coastal Protection for Local Economic Activities from Hurricanes in the Caribbean
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: In recent decades, hurricane frequency and intensity have increased in the Caribbean Basin. From 2000 to 2012, more than 100 hurricanes impacted lives, infrastructure, and economic activity along the region’s shorelines. Studies suggest that mangrove forests’ dense root systems might mitigate the impact of hurricanes, which would help stabilize the coastline and prevent erosion from waves and storms. Although many tropical mangroves are found on Caribbean coasts, climatic and anthropogenic events have been clearing these wetland ecosystems at an annual rate of 1 percent since the 1990s. This study quantifies the effects of hurricane windstorms on economic activity using nightlight as a proxy at the highest spatial resolution data available (1 square kilometer). Using different widths of the mangrove belt, it measures levels of mangrove natural protection against the impact of hurricanes and studies the broader socioeconomic and environmental effects of this protection. The results suggest that while major hurricanes reduce nightlight by approximately 2 percent and up to 16 percent in storm surge prone areas, the presence of mangroves on the coast mitigates the impact of hurricanes, reducing nightlight by 1–6 percent.
abstract_zh: 近几十年来，加勒比盆地飓风的频率和强度有所增加。2000至2012年间，超过100场飓风影响了该地区沿海的生命、基础设施和经济活动。研究表明，红树林茂密的根系可能减轻飓风的影响，有助于稳定海岸线并防止海浪和风暴造成的侵蚀。尽管许多热带红树林分布在加勒比海岸，但自20世纪90年代以来，气候和人为事件以每年1%的速度清除这些湿地生态系统。本研究以夜间灯光作为代理变量，利用可获得的最高空间分辨率数据（1平方公里），量化了飓风大风对经济活动的影响。通过使用不同宽度的红树林带，研究衡量了红树林对飓风影响的自然防护程度，并研究了这种防护的更广泛的社会经济和环境效应。结果表明，尽管大型飓风使夜间灯光减少了约2%，在风暴潮易发地区则高达16%，但海岸红树林的存在减轻了飓风的影响，使夜间灯光的减少幅度降至1%至6%。

title: Mangroves protect coastal economic activity from hurricanes
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: This paper evaluates whether mangroves can mitigate the impact of hurricanes on economic activity. The paper assembles a regionwide panel dataset that measures local economic activity using nightlights, potential hurricane damages using a detailed wind field model, and mangrove protection by mapping the width of mangrove forests on the path to the coast. The results show that hurricanes have negative short-run effects on economic activity, with losses likely concentrated in coastal lowlands that are exposed to both wind and storm surge hazards. In these coastal lowlands, the estimates show that nightlights decrease by up to 24% in areas that are unprotected by mangroves. By comparison, the impact of the hurricanes observed in the sample is fully mitigated in areas protected by mangrove belts of 1 km or more.
abstract_zh: 本文评估红树林能否减轻飓风对经济活动的影响。本文构建了一个区域性面板数据集，利用夜间灯光衡量当地经济活动，利用详细的风场模型衡量潜在的飓风破坏，并通过绘制通往海岸路径上红树林的宽度来衡量红树林的保护作用。结果显示，飓风对经济活动具有负面的短期影响，损失可能集中在同时面临风力和风暴潮灾害的沿海低地。在这些沿海低地，估计显示，在无红树林保护的地区，夜间灯光最多下降24%。相比之下，在有1公里或以上宽度红树林带保护的地区，样本中所观察到的飓风影响被完全抵消。

title: Saving Water with a Nudge (or Two): Evidence from Costa Rica on the Effectiveness and Limits of Low-Cost Behavioral Interventions on Water Use
abstract: The study uses a randomized controlled trial to test the impact of simple, inexpensive, and nonpersonalized behavioral interventions (or “nudges”) on water consumption in the context of a developing country. A descriptive social norm intervention using neighborhood comparisons reduces average water consumption in the first two postintervention months by 4.9 percent relative to the control group, while a planning postcard intervention reduces consumption by 4.8 percent. A descriptive social norm intervention using a town-level comparison also reduces water consumption by 3.2 percent, but this effect is not statistically significant. Finally, the study's one-time interventions continue to generate statistically significant reductions in water use for up to four months after they are implemented.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用随机对照试验，检验了简单、廉价且非个性化的行为干预（即“助推”）在一个发展中国家对用水量的影响。运用邻里比较的描述性社会规范干预，使干预后前两个月的平均用水量相对于对照组减少了4.9%；而规划明信片干预则使用水量减少了4.8%。使用镇级比较的描述性社会规范干预也使用水量减少了3.2%，但这一效应在统计上并不显著。最后，该研究的一次性干预在实施后长达四个月的时间里仍持续带来统计上显著的用水量减少。

title: The Fiscal Impact of Natural Resource Windfalls: Evidence from a Peruvian Natural Experiment
abstract: We study the local effect of natural resource windfalls by examining a Peruvian natural experiment. We exploit the rules governing the allocation of the Camisea Fund for Socioeconomic Development (FOCAM) to identify the effect of the associated transfers on municipal accounts, local infrastructure, and economic development. We find evidence of positive impacts on municipal capital expenditures and local infrastructure. We also find evidence of a negative impact on municipal current expenditures. Specifically, we find that municipalities with low absorptive capacity coped with the increased administrative burden of FOCAM transfers by reallocating administrative effort away from executing current expenditures. (JEL H72, O13)
abstract_zh: 我们通过考察一项秘鲁自然实验，研究了自然资源意外之财的局部效应。我们利用Camisea社会经济发展基金（FOCAM）的分配规则，识别相关转移支付对市政财政账户、地方基础设施和经济发展的影响。研究发现，转移支付对市政资本支出和地方基础设施有正向影响。我们还发现其对市政经常性支出有负向影响。具体而言，行政能力较弱的市政府通过将行政精力从执行经常性支出转向应对FOCAM转移支付带来的额外行政负担，来应对这一问题。（JEL H72, O13）

title: Weathering Storms: Understanding the Impact of Natural Disasters in Central America
abstract: In the past decades, natural disasters have caused substantial human and economic losses in Central America, with strong adverse impacts on gross domestic product per capita, income, and poverty reduction. This study provides a regional perspective on the short-term impact of hurricane windstorms on socioeconomic indicators. Apart from modeling the socioeconomic impact at the macro and micro levels, the study incorporates and juxtaposes data from a hurricane windstorm model categorizing three hurricane damage indexes, which lends a higher level of detail, nuance, and therefore accuracy and comprehensiveness to the study. One standard deviation in the intensity of a hurricane windstorm leads to a decrease in growth of total per capita gross domestic product of between 0.9 and 1.6%, and a decrease in total income and labor income by 3%, which in turn increases moderate and extreme poverty by 1.5 percentage points. These results demonstrate the causal relationship between hurricane windstorm impacts and poverty in Central America, producing regional evidence that could improve targeting of disaster risk management policies toward those most impacted and thus whose needs are greatest.
abstract_zh: 在过去几十年中，自然灾害给中美洲造成了巨大的人员和经济损失，对人均国内生产总值、收入和减贫产生了严重的不利影响。本研究从区域视角考察了飓风大风对社会经济指标的短期影响。除了在宏观和微观层面建模社会经济影响外，本研究还纳入并对照了一个飓风大风模型的数据，该模型对三种飓风损失指数进行了分类，从而使研究在细节、细微差别、准确性和全面性方面达到了更高水平。飓风大风强度每增加一个标准差，人均国内生产总值总增长率下降0.9%至1.6%，总收入和劳动收入下降3%，进而使中度和极端贫困率上升1.5个百分点。这些结果揭示了飓风大风影响与中美洲贫困之间的因果关系，提供了区域证据，有助于将灾害风险管理政策更有针对性地用于受影响最严重、需求最大的人群。

title: Particulate matter and labor supply: The role of caregiving and non-linearities
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: This paper examines the effect of air pollution on labor supply in Lima, Peru. It focuses on fine particulate matter (PM2.5), an important pollutant for health according to the medical literature, and shows that moderate levels of pollution reduce hours worked for working adults. The research design takes advantage of rich household panel data in labor outcomes to address omitted variables and allows investigation of whether the response to air pollution is non-linear. The analysis finds that the effect of moderate pollution levels on hours worked is concentrated among households with susceptible dependents, that is small children and elderly adults, while the highest concentrations affect all households. This suggests that caregiving is likely a mechanism linking air pollution to labor supply at moderate levels. Further evidence of this mechanism is provided using DHS data on children morbidity for the same time period. Finally, no evidence is found of intra-household attenuation behavior. For instance, there is no re-allocation of labor across household members, and earnings decrease with air pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了秘鲁利马空气污染对劳动供给的影响。文章聚焦于细颗粒物（PM2.5）——医学文献认为其对健康具有重要影响的一种污染物——并表明，中等水平的污染会减少在职成年人的工作时长。研究设计利用了丰富的家庭面板数据中的劳动结果，以应对遗漏变量问题，并允许检验对空气污染的反应是否具有非线性。分析发现，中等污染水平对工作时长的影响集中于拥有易感受抚养人（即幼儿和老年人）的家庭，而最高浓度的污染则影响所有家庭。这表明，在中等污染水平下，照护责任很可能是连接空气污染与劳动供给的机制。我们利用同一时期的DHS儿童发病率数据，为该机制提供了进一步证据。最后，我们未发现家庭内部存在缓解行为的证据。例如，劳动力并未在家庭成员之间重新配置，而且收入随空气污染上升而下降。

title: Effects of Protected Areas on Forest Cover Change and Local Communities: Evidence from the Peruvian Amazon
abstract: Protected areas are a cornerstone of forest conservation in developing countries. Yet we know little about their effects on forest cover change or the socioeconomic status of local communities, and even less about the relationship between these effects. This paper assesses whether 'win-win'scenarios are possible-that is, whether protected areas can both stem forest cover change and alleviate poverty. We examine protected areas in the Peruvian Amazon using high-resolution satellite images and household-level survey data for the early 2000s. To control for protected areas nonrandom siting, we rely on quasi-experimental (matching) methods. We find that the average protected area reduces forest cover change. We do not find a robust effect on local communities. Protected areas that allow sustainable extractive activities are more effective in reducing forest cover change but less effective in delivering win-win outcomes.
abstract_zh: 保护区是发展中国家森林保护的基石。然而，我们对其对森林覆盖变化或当地社区社会经济地位的影响知之甚少，对这些影响之间的关系更是知之甚少。本文评估了“双赢”情景是否可能实现，即保护区能否既遏制森林覆盖变化，又减轻贫困。我们利用高分辨率卫星图像和2000年代初的家庭层面调查数据，考察了秘鲁亚马逊地区的保护区。为控制保护区选址的非随机性，我们依赖准实验（匹配）方法。我们发现，平均而言，保护区减少了森林覆盖变化。但我们没有发现对当地社区有稳健影响。允许可持续采掘活动的保护区在减少森林覆盖变化方面更为有效，但在实现双赢成果方面效果较差。

title: Are Voters More Likely to Contribute to Other Public Goods? Evidence from a Large‐Scale Randomized Policy Experiment
The performance of non-experimental designs in the evaluation of environmental programs: A design-replication study using a large-scale randomized experiment as a benchmark
Heterogeneous treatment effects and mechanisms in information-based environmental policies: Evidence from a large-scale field experiment
The Persistence of Treatment Effects with Norm-Based Policy Instruments: Evidence from a Randomized Environmental Policy Experiment
abstract: Policymakers increasingly use norm-based messages to promote conservation efforts. Despite the apparent success of such strategies, empirical analyses have thus far focused exclusively on short-run effects. From a policy perspective, however, whether and how such strategies influence behavior in the long-run is of equal interest. We partner with a metropolitan water utility to implement a natural field experiment examining the effect of such messages on longer-run patterns of water use. Empirical results are striking. While appeals to pro-social preferences affect short-run patterns of water use, only messages augmented with social comparisons have a lasting impact on water demand.
abstract_zh: 政策制定者越来越多地使用基于规范的信息来促进节约保护。尽管此类策略看似成功，但实证分析迄今为止仅关注短期效应。然而，从政策角度看，这类策略是否以及如何影响长期行为同样值得关注。我们与一家大都市供水公用事业合作，开展了一项自然田野实验，考察此类信息对长期用水模式的影响。实证结果十分引人注目。尽管亲社会偏好的诉求会影响短期用水模式，但只有辅以社会比较的信息才具有持久的影响，从而对用水需求产生持续作用。
